QUOTE: `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free` is only declared in the runtime configuration. Calling it when the macros are set is a compile error.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the function is only declared in the runtime configuration, so with the macros set it is not declared and calling it fails to compile. Together with "`platform.c`'s pointer block is compiled out", this covers the "neither declared nor compiled" claim.
